scientific_integrity: Full analytical proof of every population and real gap ratio, with independent exact-rational finite checks and symbolic algebra verification; no experimental interpolation is used as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The statement is for exactly three occupied real-line sites and the Global Pair/Pairwise-Distance rule; the general four-approximation and the mechanism are credited to prior work. Does not cover more distinct sites, other metrics, other rules, or incentive analyses. Independently unvalidated; unindexed equivalent results cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact finite-population phase transition for three-site distance-weighted two-facility location
